title: Castelion footer
description: A page-colour footer under a 2px navy rule: an italic wordmark, three short columns of navy links and two office towns at the right, then the copyright left and legal links right. It ends in a block of full-width navy stripes that thicken steadily downwards, from a hairline to a heavy bar. Links underline on hover.
notes: the stripes use the text colour (navy on cream; cream in dark mode)
